'''Sohima''' was a town in [[Seanchan]].

Recently, the [[Great Fire of Sohima]] caused great destruction to the town, destroying most, if not all, of the town. [[Furyk Karede]] was in Sohima during the fire. In it he lost a doll named Emela, given to him by [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]].{{ref/book|10|4}}. His wife [[Kalia Karede|Kalia]] and one of his sons perished in the fire.<ref name=comp>[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Kalia.</ref>
